description: Fuzzy-search ranking weights for the emojig search engine. Consumed by the Zig app (src/search.zig, src/root.zig) and mirrored into the website simulator via scripts/gen_web_spec. All weights are integers; the final score of a term match is the sum of per-character scores minus penalties. Read docs/SearchEngine.md before tuning: the ranking tests in src/ranking_test.zig pin the relative order of hundreds of queries, so any change here must keep `zig build test` green.
